advisory_mechanism: Initial unsafe-option lists omitted archive --add-file/--add-virtual-file and clone --bundle-uri; fix adds those residual tokens to the same guards
vulnerable_source: caller kwargs selecting archive --add-file/--add-virtual-file or clone --bundle-uri
vulnerable_sink: Repo.archive git archive reads/injects caller-controlled files; Repo.clone git clone --bundle-uri fetches a caller-controlled URI
security_invariant: archive denylist must include --add-file/--add-virtual-file and clone denylist must include --bundle-uri unless allow_unsafe_options is explicit

advisory_mechanism: blame revision/option guard omits --contents/-S and returns an arbitrary local file through blame output
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled blame revision and kwargs containing --contents/-S, including positional/cluster forms
vulnerable_sink: Repo.blame -> git blame --contents/-S reads and returns the named local file
security_invariant: blame/revision unsafe-option validation must cover file-read options and positional option clusters

advisory_mechanism: clone denylist omitted --template so caller-controlled templates can install executable hooks during clone
vulnerable_source: Repo.clone / clone_from template/--template caller argument
vulnerable_sink: git clone --template copies attacker-controlled executable hook files into the new repository
security_invariant: clone must gate --template as unsafe before invoking git clone

advisory_mechanism: Diffable.diff forwards caller option kwargs including --output without the unsafe-option gate
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled Diffable.diff option kwargs selecting output/output=<path>
vulnerable_sink: git diff --output writes to the attacker-selected filesystem path
security_invariant: unsafe diff file-write options must be denied unless allow_unsafe_options is explicit

advisory_mechanism: single-character kwargs are split into an option token plus a separate value token; the unsafe-option builder checked only the keyword name, so a dash-prefixed value bypassed clone/remote/revision/blame/archive guards
vulnerable_source: caller kwargs with a one-character key and a dash-prefixed value under split_single_char_options
vulnerable_sink: Git._option_candidates in git/cmd.py emits the value as an additional argv option token consumed by clone, remote, revision, blame, and archive Git invocations
security_invariant: dash-prefixed values of split short options must be included in unsafe-option candidates

advisory_mechanism: Commit.count forwards kwargs to git rev-list without the unsafe-option validation used by sibling revision APIs
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled Commit.count kwargs selecting --output / output=<path>
vulnerable_sink: git rev-list --output writes to the attacker-selected filesystem path
security_invariant: Commit.count must run Git.check_unsafe_options against unsafe_git_rev_options unless allow_unsafe_options is explicit

advisory_mechanism: native prompt/history image auto-load reads out-of-workspace local paths despite tools.fs.workspaceOnly
vulnerable_source: local path, file URL, or sandbox-mounted path detected in prompt/history image references
vulnerable_sink: detectAndLoadPromptImages -> loadImageFromRef -> loadWebMedia reads bytes and injects them as vision input
security_invariant: workspaceOnly must be enforced before native prompt/history image filesystem reads

advisory_mechanism: small compressed images declare oversized dimensions and reach metadata/decode/resize backends before a pixel cap
vulnerable_source: untrusted image bytes with huge or overflowed width and height headers
vulnerable_sink: Sharp or macOS sips metadata, orientation, decode, conversion, and resize operations
security_invariant: pixel count and dimension validity must be checked before any image backend work

advisory_mechanism: calendar deletion lacks ownership
vulnerable_source: authenticated request carrying a sequential calendar event id
vulnerable_sink: CalendarDeleteEventController.php Calendar::find($id)->delete() with no user_id filter
security_invariant: calendar event deletion must load by id AND user_id=Auth::user()->id before delete

advisory_mechanism: Authenticated notification delete uses an unscoped sequential id and does not verify user ownership
vulnerable_source: authenticated request carrying a sequential notification id
vulnerable_sink: DeleteNotificationController.php Notification::findOrFail($id) then delete with no user_id filter
security_invariant: notification deletion must filter id AND user_id=Auth::id() before delete

release_boundary.content_result_vulnerable: Notification::findOrFail(id) then delete with no ownership filter

advisory_mechanism: AI-authored upstream senderName allowlist grant imported as a new OpenClaw Feishu surface; no claim that OpenClaw created the upstream bug
vulnerable_source: mutable Feishu senderName / allowFrom grant copied by OpenClaw import 2267d58a from upstream root 4286755f
vulnerable_sink: extensions/feishu/src/policy.ts allowlist matching used by bot authorization
security_invariant: group sender allowlisting must match immutable sender id, not a caller-mutable senderName

advisory_mechanism: token-authenticated no-device lower-privilege WebSocket clients receive admin-sensitive hello-ok snapshot fields
vulnerable_source: token-authenticated WebSocket connect with device=null and non-admin scopes
vulnerable_sink: buildGatewaySnapshot hello-ok exposes configPath, stateDir, and authMode
security_invariant: sensitive snapshot metadata must be included only when effective scopes contain operator.admin

advisory_mechanism: upstream Claude atomic first creates Feishu media local-path read; OpenClaw 2267d58a is import carrier; fix deletes that branch
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled local filesystem path in Feishu mediaUrl / sendMediaFeishu
vulnerable_sink: extensions/feishu/src/media.ts fs.readFileSync(filePath) local-read branch
security_invariant: Feishu media loading must not read arbitrary local paths; local-read branch must be removed

advisory_mechanism: allowInsecureAuth lets token/password Control UI sessions bypass secure-context and paired-device requirements
vulnerable_source: Control UI WebSocket connect over insecure context with allowInsecureAuth=true and missing device identity
vulnerable_sink: gateway message-handler allowControlUiBypass authorizes the no-device handshake
security_invariant: allowInsecureAuth must not bypass secure context or device authentication; only explicit dangerouslyDisableDeviceAuth may do so

advisory_mechanism: untrusted Feishu imageKey/fileKey interpolated into os.tmpdir() filenames; UUID replacement is the minimum reversal
vulnerable_source: untrusted Feishu image_key / file_key returned to downloadImageFeishu and downloadMessageResourceFeishu
vulnerable_sink: extensions/feishu/src/media.ts path.join(os.tmpdir(), `feishu_img_${Date.now()}_${imageKey}`) and `feishu_${Date.now()}_${fileKey}` then writeFile
security_invariant: temporary media paths must not interpolate untrusted keys; UUID (or equivalent non-attacker) names must be used

advisory_mechanism: Token-auth skip of device identity has no role gate, so role=node can connect with device:null
vulnerable_source: WebSocket connectParams with auth.token present, device=null, and role=node
vulnerable_sink: src/gateway/server/ws-connection/message-handler.ts token-auth device skip allows the node handshake
security_invariant: node must not skip device identity; missing device plus role=node must fail closed

advisory_mechanism: upstream atomic creates unguarded remote fetch of Feishu mediaUrl; OpenClaw import carrier 2267d58a; fix 5b4121d6 routes remote loads through hardened helpers
vulnerable_source: caller-controlled remote mediaUrl / docx URL in Feishu sendMediaFeishu
vulnerable_sink: extensions/feishu/src/media.ts fetch(mediaUrl) remote-load branch
security_invariant: every discovered remote media URL must be revalidated before fetch; unguarded fetch must not remain

advisory_mechanism: The sandboxed image tool resolved mounted paths without propagating tools.fs.workspaceOnly, allowing out-of-workspace image bytes to reach a vision provider
vulnerable_source: sandbox-mounted or caller-supplied image filePath reaching createImageTool when workspaceOnly is set on tools.fs
vulnerable_sink: src/agents/tools/image-tool.ts resolveSandboxedImagePath reads hostPath and returns bytes to the vision provider
security_invariant: when tools.fs.workspaceOnly is set, image-tool sandbox resolution must call assertSandboxPath before reading

advisory_mechanism: stripBotMention interpolates mention.name and mention.key into new RegExp without escaping
vulnerable_source: Feishu mention metadata mention.name and mention.key
vulnerable_sink: extensions/feishu/src/bot.ts stripBotMention new RegExp(`@${mention.name}\s*`) and new RegExp(mention.key)
security_invariant: mention name and key must be regex-escaped before interpolation into RegExp, matching extractMessageBody

advisory_mechanism: upstream root creates parentId->getMessageFeishu->quotedContent agent context that checks the triggering sender only, not the fetched quoted/root/thread sender
vulnerable_source: Feishu parentId / quoted/root/thread message fetch used as agent context
vulnerable_sink: extensions/feishu/src/bot.ts getMessageFeishu quotedContent injected into agent context
security_invariant: quoted, root, and thread fetched context must pass the group sender allowlist, not only the triggering sender

advisory_mechanism: native prompt-image autoload caller into the Windows UNC/file URL loader only
vulnerable_source: Windows UNC path or file: URL supplied to native prompt-image / WhatsApp media autoload
vulnerable_sink: src/media/web-media.ts and extensions/whatsapp/src/media.ts loaders fetch or read the UNC/file URL, including remote-host file URLs
security_invariant: native media loaders must block remote-host file URLs and UNC workspace-seam paths before read/fetch

advisory_mechanism: Candidate 079af0d0 continues a token-present connection without device pairing; parent-copied connectParams.scopes (or default operator.admin) take effect on that path; fix 5e389d5e always clears unbound scopes
vulnerable_source: WebSocket connectParams.auth.token presence plus self-declared connectParams.scopes
vulnerable_sink: message-handler.ts scopes assignment on the token-auth/no-device connect path
security_invariant: scopes on a device-less shared-auth connection must be cleared or bound, not client-declared

advisory_mechanism: Candidate 079af0d0 sets hasTokenAuth = !!connectParams.auth?.token and skips device identity before the token is validated; fix fe81b1d7 authorizes first and sets canSkipDevice = sharedAuthOk
vulnerable_source: unvalidated connectParams.auth.token presence
vulnerable_sink: message-handler.ts device-required gate if (!device && !hasTokenAuth)
security_invariant: missing device identity may be skipped only after shared auth succeeds, not because a token string is present
